title: Hapbeat Release Feed
description: Latest published version of each Hapbeat tool / SDK, aggregated from the actual distribution channels (PyPI / npm / PlatformIO registry / GitHub tags for UPM). Consumed by Studio, hapbeat-helper and the SDKs to surface update notices — see specs/release-feed.md (DEC-053). Device firmware is NOT listed here; it ships through the firmware distribution manifest.

products.description: Product id (repo name without the `hapbeat-` prefix) → entry. Products whose channel lookup failed are omitted entirely rather than carrying a stale or placeholder version.

name.description: Display name as it appears on the distribution channel (e.g. `hapbeat-helper`, `@hapbeat/sdk`).

channel.description: Where the user actually gets this product.

published_at.description: Release timestamp. Omitted when the channel does not expose one.

severity.description: `info` = badge / one-line log only. `recommended` = a dismissible banner is allowed. Either way a given version is surfaced at most once per user (see specs/release-feed.md §5.1).

upgrade.description: Upgrade command (e.g. `pipx upgrade hapbeat-helper`) or the URL to update to (UPM git URL).
